generator.name: hand-authored plan
generator.note: nothing is generated at load time; the document is the resolved result

notes.hub: Hub (11.2, an toàn, 15 phút qua nhiều lần ghé): "ấm nhỏ biết giá của nó" — nghèo, ướt, không phải làng fantasy ấm cúng. Nhà sàn trên than bùn ướt, lối ván qua mặt hồ, tường đá lửa vá, rào liễu, giếng, giá lờ lươn, lò rèn Brannoc, bảng tên người ngủ, chuông tang, sạp Nell, trạm gác Osric, hố cắt than bùn (nước đen) ở phía đông; nhánh poppy trên cửa là accent duy nhất.
notes.churchyard: Churchyard (11.3, wild, 20 phút, D2 C2): dốc từ cửa nhà thờ xuống cổng lychgate; mộ thấp, thủy tùng chỉ ở rìa, mortsafe, cụm bia lệch, xe tang, giá treo cổ hắc ín + quạ, tượng không mặt trên lối đi, nến hũ trên mộ. Năm mộ chưa yên (rite), mỗi chỗ một cảnh. Mưa phùn, ánh sáng xám không bóng; sau 5 rite: sương mỏng đi, quạ đậu lại.

code.note: sha256 of the listed lab source files at export time; labCommit = lookdev-lab HEAD; uncommitted = listed files that differ from HEAD (the export used the working tree)

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).

heightfield.note: final ground height after base, hills, flattens, edge falloff, water beds, dikes and structure pads; bilinear sampling reproduces the lab ground

N01.name: Barrow family vault door (portal in the terrace wall)
N01.note: side quest One for the Footing; under the ossuary, faces the village. GLB 3.7 × 2.8 × 1.07 m (keyed on the 2.8 m height; on the 2.4 m width it would stand 1.82 m with a 1.37 m door): the portal and its own short flint wall section, door ≈1.5 × 2.1 m, face +z flush with the N02 wall face; the terrace wall runs stop at its two clean ends (x ±1.85); a mirrored door on its back is buried in the hill. Blocks only up to its visible faces (measured on the GLB, review a2x F-a), each back to the bbox back (−0.536): the wall section to +0.12 (its flint face +0.07…+0.09 over the foot ferns), the arch surround (x −1.2…+1.12) to +0.21 (jambs +0.17…+0.19), the 0.16 m threshold step (x −0.8…+0.75) to +0.38 (its front +0.30…+0.41); the fern clumps at its foot (to +0.53, the bbox front) are walk-through like all low plants

N02.name: Flint retaining wall (vault terrace)
N02.note: keeps the hub terrace from the summit: the lychgate stays the only way into the churchyard. GLB 4 × 2.16 × 0.73 m (outer face +z, pale quoins at both ends, coping top ≈2.08 m; the face is loose panels in front of a frame): the runs stand it ×1.55 (6.2 m modules, 3.35 m tall, coping ≈3.22 m: the def is 3.2 m) with the outer face to the terrace, and a 0.2 m parapet over the uphill ground (not the default 0.6 × height, which would stretch it ×1.6). Its flint face is ≈0.14 m in front of the run line (the bbox front is the ferns at its foot): the runs stand with the face 0.18 m inside the terrace's flat edge, so the edge's ramp up to the hill lies inside the wall (outside its face the ramp hid the lower 2 m). Blocks only up to its flint face (z −0.364…+0.12 of the GLB; the face +0.09, p99 +0.10 at walking height; review a2x F-a): the fern clumps at its foot (to +0.25 in the walk band, the bbox front +0.364) are walk-through like all low plants
